what: Walla's fight proven against BN4's own (walla_v1-v3 PASS) and Elmperor's collision data mapped: MegaMan's struck state (BN4_PLAYER_STRUCK 0x08010960, BN6's 0x080174FE setting 0x400000 with its 0x400), the effect an attack's hits make (BN4_HIT_EFFECT 0x08012F44, which Walla's ring calls, spawning the spark), the poison panel's step (BN4_POISON_STEP 0x08013010: BN4's collision data +6 is BN6's +8, BN6_COLL_POISON_TIMER) and the sprite update (BN4_SPRITE_UPDATE 0x0800285C), docs/rom/bn4.md's row; the blink's phase opposite in the two (BN4_BLINK_FLASHING), MegaMan's struck animation cut otherwise by each game's art (24 frames each)
